_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for scholarly metadata used by the /cite/ page, bibliography files, page <meta>/JSON-LD and CITATION.cff. Edit this file by hand; the generator (build_cite.py) only reads it. A value of null means 'not verified / does not exist yet' and is never replaced by a guess. Never put a placeholder DOI or ORCID here.

author.affiliation: Department of Biological Sciences, Texas Tech University
author._orcid_note: Leave null until the author supplies the verified identifier (https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000 form).

site.name: Drosie's World
site.year_note: No site-wide publication date is documented; resources are cited as n.d. unless a verified date exists below.

_license_note: No licence has been chosen (see PR #16, docs/LICENSING_PROPOSAL.md). Leave null; do not add one here until the author decides.

book.title: Drosie, the Fruit Fly
book.illustrator_note: Illustrator attribution is preserved in every format. Artwork is used with the illustrator's permission; the licensing scope is as agreed with her and is not stated or extended here.
needs_manual_verification: Author name string on the Zenodo record (this repo uses 'Shahira Helal Arzoo'; the site and PR #16 use 'Arzoo, S.')
Publication date and version on the Zenodo record (year 2026, Version 1.0 are taken from existing site text)
Whether the Zenodo record lists the illustrator, and the record's licence/rights statement
Resource type on Zenodo (book vs. other)

software._note: Fill in only after a human-approved archive exists (see PR #16). doi must be the real DOI assigned by the archive.
